newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 27.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Top Chinese economist Qiu Xiaohua predicts stable development for the national economy in 1997 with an economic growth rate of 10 percent and inflation falling to a year-on-year rate of less than five percent.
- China stock trading stamp tax income surged to 2.54 billion yuan in April, 55 times that of April last year.
- Commentary criticises some listed firms for changing time and venue of shareholders' meetings at random.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The centre of China's energy industry has shifted to the interior areas in the west and middle of China.
- Commentary warns against possibility of international speculative funds flowing into China.
